groups.title: Launch-blocking functional criteria
groups.severityReason: The observe, intervene, branch, compare and preserve loop must work before public release.

criteria.requirement: A user can load a compatible local model or immediately open a bundled verified trace.
A prompt is tokenised and produces a real next-token candidate field.
Generation can pause before sampling.
Temperature, top-k, top-p and seed affect the sampler according to documented rules.
A candidate can be suppressed or forced and the intervention remains visible in lineage.
A child branch does not mutate its ancestor.
Two compatible branches can be compared from their shared ancestor.
A trace exports, validates, imports and replays with the same selected tokens.
Every instrument and explanation exposes evidence classification.
Unsupported hardware receives a useful fallback rather than a dead end.

groups.title: Mathematical unit tests
groups.severityReason: Exact sampler mathematics underpins both teaching and verified measured traces.

criteria.requirement: Stable softmax handles large logits; probabilities remain finite and sum to one.
Temperature has T=1 identity, sharpens below one, flattens above one and rejects invalid values.
Top-k handles k=1, vocabulary-sized k and stable ties according to the documented order.
Top-p applies its boundary rule, retains at least one candidate, handles p=1 and rejects invalid values.
Survivor probabilities renormalise to one after every filter combination.
A known seed yields the fixture sequence and deterministic interval boundaries.
Entropy matches reference distributions and handles zero probabilities.
Divergence accepts compatible distributions only and handles zero and identical cases.

groups.title: Model correctness tests
groups.severityReason: Only a pinned, independently checked output profile may enter a verified measured trace.

criteria.requirement: Tokenizer IDs and decoded fragments match the pinned reference tokenizer.
Final logits match source-framework golden fixtures within an explicit backend tolerance.
Any promoted hidden-state or attention output matches the reference export for selected fixtures.
criteria.severityReason: Phase 5 keeps hidden-state and attention outputs unavailable and authorises zero capture bytes.

criteria.requirement: Causal masking and sequence-position semantics are verified.
Quantised builds are evaluated separately and never imply numerical identity with full precision.
Model, tokenizer and runtime hashes are captured and displayed.

groups.title: Trace and replay tests
groups.severityReason: The trace is the Observatory's portable scientific record and must remain exact and immutable.

criteria.requirement: Schema validation rejects missing required fields and unknown breaking versions.
Export and import preserve prompt IDs, sampler state, PRNG state, interventions and lineage.
Replay reproduces selected tokens for golden traces.
Branch creation uses the correct parent and fork step.
Ancestor content remains byte-stable after descendant changes.
Compatibility warnings appear for different model, tokenizer or calculation versions.
Migrations are explicit, tested and never silently reinterpret measurements.

groups.title: End-to-end scenarios
groups.severityReason: Each scenario exercises a public path or a recovery boundary that supports the release claim.

criteria.requirement: On first visit a user can choose demonstration mode, force the runner-up and save the branch.
A supported desktop can cache the model, enter a prompt, pause, inspect and sample five tokens.
Greedy and seeded stochastic branches can be run and their first divergence located.
Suppressing the top candidate updates the explanation and the trace can be exported.
A known trace imports, replays, forks at step three and accepts an annotation.
With WebGPU denied, WASM or the demo trace still completes a guided experiment.
Interrupted download or inference recovers without corrupting cached model or trace state.

groups.title: Visual and interaction acceptance
groups.severityReason: The instrument must communicate state and limitations without relying on decoration or guesswork.

criteria.requirement: Current token, step, selected instrument and evidence class are always identifiable.
Candidate ranking and probabilities remain legible at normal laptop size.
Scale changes and filtered candidates are explicit.
Branch lineage identifies the intervention point and selected comparison tips.
No major view is a placeholder, decorative chart or unlabelled approximation.
Loading, empty, unsupported, stale and error states are intentionally designed.
Reduced-motion mode removes nonessential animation.

groups.title: Accessibility acceptance
groups.severityReason: The core learning loop must remain perceivable and operable under WCAG 2.2 AA expectations.

criteria.requirement: A keyboard-only user can complete prompt, pause, intervene, branch, compare and save.
Focus order follows the workflow and focus is always visible.
Controls expose accessible names, current values, ranges and error messages.
Charts provide equivalent readable values or summaries.
Colour is never the only evidence-class, rank, branch or error cue.
Text and controls meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and target-size expectations where applicable.
Live updates are announced without overwhelming screen-reader users.

groups.title: Performance and resilience
groups.severityReason: A local-first instrument must fail safely and avoid resource growth or corrupted evidence.

criteria.requirement: Model execution and tensor processing cause no sustained main-thread blocking.
Capability detection completes before risky allocation and explains the chosen mode.
Model loading and prediction can be cancelled safely.
Repeated experiments do not exhibit unbounded tensor or session growth.
Cache quota failure has clear recovery and cannot corrupt the notebook.
A cached model or bundled trace remains usable on an offline revisit where deployment permits.
Large traces warn, bound optional capture or offer a compact export.

groups.title: Browser and device matrix
groups.severityReason: Every published support cell must be backed by measured capability and journey evidence.

criteria.requirement: Current Chromium desktop with WebGPU has a measured experimental support result.
criteria.severityReason: WebGPU is inspection-only and is not required for the core release path.

criteria.requirement: Current Chromium without WebGPU reaches the WASM or demonstration path.
Firefox and Safari support levels are documented from real capability results rather than assumed.
Android tablet and phone demonstration or reduced-instrument modes are tested.
A low-memory device receives preflight warning and safe model-size and context limits.
criteria.severityReason: The optional model can be withheld while the instant teaching path remains useful.

groups.title: Scientific-integrity acceptance
groups.severityReason: Public copy and instruments must not overstate what the accepted output profile measures.

criteria.requirement: Attention is never labelled as causal importance.
A projection exposes its method and limitations.
criteria.severityReason: Semantic projection remains unavailable throughout Phase 5.

criteria.requirement: Probe outputs are labelled Probed and versioned.
criteria.severityReason: Logit-lens and other probes remain unavailable throughout Phase 5.

criteria.requirement: Demonstration and live inference are unmistakably different.
Selection explanations reconstruct the recorded sampler process.
Interventions list exactly what changed and what remained fixed.
No user-facing copy anthropomorphises the model's internal state.

groups.title: Release handback
groups.severityReason: A release claim requires a reviewable evidence pack rather than an informal checklist.

criteria.requirement: The handback provides exact test results.
The handback provides supported-browser evidence.
The handback provides performance measurements.
The handback provides known limitations.
The handback provides current hero-loop screenshots or recordings.
The handback provides sample trace fixtures.
The handback states which instruments are Measured, Derived, Projected, Probed or Interventional.
